title: Covers of curves, Ceresa cycles, and Unlikely intersections
summary: Fix a smooth, projective, geometrically integral curve $C$ of genus $g \geq 2$ over a characteristic zero field. We prove that the Ceresa cycle $\mathrm{Cer}(\widetilde{C})$ of a very general ramified cover $\widetilde{C}$ of $C$ is nontorsion in the Chow group of its Jacobian. We also show that there exist infinitely many families of ramified covers of a varying family of curves where a general point of these families corresponds to a curve with nontorsion Ceresa cycle.
